utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Oh. Okay.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Which reps are the batch ones? I won't ask for names. I mean how many.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Still the same. Twenty-three at last count.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Okay. Three fields, amount, close date and product, plus the survey link going out automatically. That's the setup now.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Great. Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Meera
utterances.text: I think maybe I should tell Rafael's team? They did the trial for us.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Thank them. Don't tell them the rest, I'll send the note.

utterances.speaker: Meera
utterances.text: Okay. I'll just say thanks.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: And tell them it wasn't a waste.

utterances.speaker: Meera
utterances.text: I think maybe I'll leave out the waste part.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Sione needs the three fields written down so he doesn't guess. Sven?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Yep. I'll, uh, send him the list.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Today.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Today. Yes.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Should I remove the other five from the report, or leave them as columns?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Leave them. They'll be empty on new ones, it's fine.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Quick unrelated thing. Is anyone going to Gabor's thing Thursday? The vendor lunch.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I might. Depends on the call with Irina.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: He still owes me an email.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Third time's the charm.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Fourth, now.

utterances.speaker: Meera
utterances.text: I think maybe he's out? Sunita said he was traveling.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Of course he is.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Is the room the same next week? The cold one?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I asked facilities. They said they'd look.

utterances.speaker: Meera
utterances.text: I brought a jacket. It's in my bag.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: I have a spare one if anyone needs it.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: I'm good. I just think in general we should have a thermostat person.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: We have a facilities team.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: A person who owns it. Big picture.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Okay. Anything else on the close screen?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Nope.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: Meera
utterances.text: I think maybe not. Um, no.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Good. I've got to jump. Same time next week.
